αἵματός: αἷμα — blood; neut. gen. sg., of origin after ἐξ, accented before the enclitic εἰσι: ’of (your) blood’
αὐτόθεν: αὐτόθεν — from that very spot, right there; adv.
βλάβεται: βλάπτω — hurt, hinder; pres. 3 sg. pass., epic βλάβεται (= Attic βλάπτεται): ’is hampered’
γέγον: γίγνομαι — become, be born; perf. 3 sg., elided (γέγον’ = γέγονε): ’has been born, has come to be’
γενέθλης: γενέθλη — stock, race, offspring; fem. gen. sg., of origin after ἐξ, with σῆς: ’of (your) stock’
γνῶτε: γιγνώσκω — come to know, understand; aor. imper. 2 pl. act.: ’take note of, grasp’
δολοφροσύνην: δολοφροσύνη — craftiness, guile; fem. acc. sg., object of ἐνόησεν: ’the guile’
δολοφροσύνῃς: δολοφροσύνη — craftiness, guile; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic -αις), of means: ’by wiles’
δυνάμην: δύναμαι — be able, can; impf. 1 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδυνάμην): ’I could’
εἰλειθυίας: Εἰλείθυια — Eileithyia, goddess of childbirth; fem. acc. pl.: ’the Eileithyiae’ (the birth-goddesses in the plural)
εἷλ: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (εἷλ’ = εἷλε): ’seized’
εὐρυσθεὺς: Εὐρυσθεύς — Eurystheus, king of Mycenae and Argos; masc. nom. sg., in apposition to ἀνήρ
θῆλυς: θῆλυς — female; adj. fem. nom. sg., with ἐοῦσα: ’though a female, a mere woman’
κλοτοπεύειν: κλοτοπεύω — dawdle, waste time (rare, sense from ancient gloss); pres. inf. act., after οὐ χρή: ’to dawdle’
κράατα: κάρη, κάρα — head; neut. acc. pl., epic κράατα (not found in Attic prose), after κατά: ’(over) the heads’
λελαθέσθ: λανθάνομαι — forget (+ gen.); reduplicated aor. inf. mid., elided (λελαθέσθ’ = λελαθέσθαι; Attic ἐπιλαθέσθαι): ’to forget’
λιπαροπλοκάμοιο: λιπαρόπλοκαμος — with shining locks (λιπαρός + πλόκαμος); adj. of two endings, fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with κεφαλῆς
μείς: μείς — month; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic μήν), with ἕβδομος
μῦθόν: μῦθος — word, speech; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε: ’the word’
νεικείεσκον: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; impf. 1 sg./3 pl. iterative, epic -εσκον, unaugmented and uncontracted (Attic ἐνείκουν): ’they would reproach’
οἴσουσ: φέρω — bear, carry; fut. 3 pl., elided (οἴσουσ’ = οἴσουσι): ’they will bring’
οὐλομένη: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., epic οὐλομένη (= Attic ὀλομένη), used as adj.: ’accursed, ruinous’
πέσῃ: πίπτω — fall; aor. subj. 3 sg. (ἔπεσον), general clause after ὅς κεν: ’shall fall’ (here of a birth, ’be born’)
πίλναται: πίλναμαι — draw near, come close to; pres. 3 sg. mid. (Attic πελάζεται): ’draws near to, touches’
παρασχέμεν: παρέχω — hold out, furnish; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic παρασχεῖν): ’to furnish, to hand over’
περιστρέψας: περιστρέφω — whirl round, twirl; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having whirled’
περσηϊάδαο: Περσηϊάδης — son of Perseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), patronymic of Sthenelus
πολλῷ: πολύς — much, great; masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ὁμάδῳ: ’great’
σθενέλοιο: Σθένελος — Sthenelus, son of Perseus, father of Eurystheus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with πάϊς
σθενέλου: Σθένελος — Sthenelus, son of Perseus, father of Eurystheus; masc. gen. sg., with ἄλοχον
στενάχεσχ: στενάχω — groan, lament; impf. 3 sg. iterative, epic -εσκε, elided (στενάχεσχ’ = στενάχεσκε; Attic ἐστέναζε): ’he used to groan over’
σύνθεσθ: συντίθεμαι — put together in the mind, heed; aor. imper. 2 pl. mid., elided (σύνθεσθ’ = σύνθεσθε): ’give heed’
τέξεσθαι: τίκτω — bear, give birth to; fut. inf. mid. (Attic τέξεσθαι), dependent on ἔμελλε: ’to bear’
φασ: φημί — say; pres. 3 pl., elided (φασ’ = φασί): ’they say’
ψευστήσεις: ψευστέω — be false, play false (a rare epic verb); fut. 2 sg. act.: ’you will prove false’
ἀάσθην: ἀάω — blind, bewilder; aor. pass. 1 sg.: ’I was bewildered’
ἀλκμήνη: Ἀλκμήνη — Alcmene, mother of Heracles; fem. nom. sg., subject of τέξεσθαι
ἀνάξει: ἀνάσσω — be lord of, rule over (+ dat.); fut. 3 sg. (Attic ἀνάξει): ’will rule’
ἀνάξειν: ἀνάσσω — be lord of, rule over (+ dat.); fut. inf. act., after ἦ μέν in an oath: ’that he shall rule’
ἀναστάς: ἀνίστημι — raise up; intrans. aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having risen up, standing up’
ἀπάτησεν: ἀπατάω — deceive, trick; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’deceived’
ἀπειπόντος: ἀπεῖπον — renounce, give up; aor. part. act. masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Πηλεΐωνος: ’having renounced’
ἀργικέραυνε: ἀργικέραυνος — of the flashing thunderbolt; masc. voc. sg., epithet of Zeus
ἀχαιικόν: Ἀχαιϊκός — Achaean; adj. neut. acc. sg., with Ἄργος: ’Achaean (Argos)’
ἀᾶται: ἀάω — blind, bewilder; pres. 3 sg., epic -ᾶται (mid. form with active force): ’bewilders’
ἁπαλοὶ: ἁπαλός — soft, tender; masc. nom. pl., agreeing with πόδες
ἄρεκτον: ἄρεκτος — not done, undone (ἀ- + ῥέζω); adj. neut. nom. sg., predicate with ἔργον: ’still undone’
ἄσατο: ἀάω — blind, bewilder; aor. 3 sg. mid., intrans. epic ἄσατο (= ἀάσατο): ’was bewildered’
ἐκφανεῖ: ἐκφαίνω — bring to light, show forth; fut. 3 sg. contracted (ἐκφανέει): ’will bring forth’
ἐκύει: κυέω — be pregnant with, carry in the womb; impf. 3 sg.: ’was carrying’
ἐνδείξομαι: ἐνδείκνυμι — point out, show; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall make plain’
ἐπειγόμενός: ἐπείγω — press, urge on; mid./pass. ἐπείγομαι be in haste, be eager for (+ gen.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg., accented before περ: ’eager’
ἐπιθήσεις: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, add; fut. 2 sg. act., + dat.: ’you will put on’ (with τέλος, ’bring to fulfilment’)
ἐπισταμένῳ: ἐπίσταμαι — know, understand, be skilled; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., with ἐόντι: ’for one who is skilled’
ἐρινύς: Ἐρινύς — Erinys, avenging spirit, a Fury; fem. nom. sg.
ἐϋστεφάνῳ: ἐΰστέφανος — well-crowned; adj. of two endings, dat. sg. (fem. when it agrees with Θήβῃ, epithet of Thebe)
ἑσταότος: ἵστημι — set, stand; perf. part. act. masc. gen. sg., epic ἑσταότος (= Attic ἑστῶτος): ’of one standing’
ἔρριψεν: ῥίπτω — throw, fling; aor. 3 sg. act., with ρρ doubled after the augment (= Attic ἔρριψε(ν)): ’flung’
ἕβδομος: ἕβδομος — seventh; ordinal adj., masc. nom. sg., with μείς: ’the seventh (month)’
ἕδρης: ἕδρη — seat; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic ἕδρας), after ἐκ: ’from (his) seat’
ἠλιτόμηνον: ἠλιτόμηνος — born before its month, premature (ἁλιτ- ’miss’ + μείς; sense partly guessed); masc. acc. sg., with ἐόντα
ἰφθίμην: ἴφθιμος — mighty, stout; fem. acc. sg., with ἄλοχον: ’stalwart’
ὀλέκεσκεν: ὀλέκω — destroy, kill; impf. 3 sg. iterative, epic -εσκε(ν), unaugmented (Attic ὤλλυ): ’kept destroying’
ὁρῷτο: ὁράω — see; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid. (= Attic ὁρῴη), in a past general clause after ὅθ’: ’whenever he saw’
ὄμοσεν: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ὤμοσε): ’swore’
ὑββάλλειν: ὑποβάλλω — throw under; interrupt a speaker; pres. inf. act., ὑπο- assimilated (ὑββάλλειν = ὑποβάλλειν): ’to interrupt’
ὤμοσε: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’swore’
ῥέξαιμι: ῥέζω — do, perform (= Attic δράω, ποιέω); aor. opt. 1 sg., potential with κεν: ’I could do’

__broaden__.ἔειπον: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 1 sg., epic ἔειπον (= Attic εἶπον): ’I spoke’ · also aor. 3 pl., with Ἀχαιοί as subject: ’they said’
__broaden__.ἀκούσαι: ἀκούω — hear; aor. opt. 3 sg. act. in -αι (= Attic ἀκούσειε), in a condition: ’should hear’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. act., potential with κεν: ’could hear’ (πῶς κέν τις ἀκούσαι ’how could anyone hear’)
__broaden__.τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with which’ (τῇ … ἐπισσείων ’shaking which’) · also fem. dat. sg. demonstrative, with ἐνί: ’by it’ (of a shield-rim, τῇ … ἐνὶ βλαφθεὶς ’hindered by it’) · also fem. dat. sg. of possession, ’she has’ (τῇ … ἁπαλοὶ πόδες ’her feet are tender’)
__broaden__.χαλεπὸν: χαλεπός — harsh, grievous, painful; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with γῆρας: ’harsh’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an implied infinitive as subject: ’(it is) hard’
__broaden__.σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέπας: ’your (cup)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κλέος: ’your (fame)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἑταῖρον: ’your (companion)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with γένος: ’your (offspring)’
__broaden__.κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κέν … κατέπαυσε ’would have stopped’) · also with αἴ + subj. in a condition: ’if perhaps … can’ · also with the opt., potential: ’could, would’ (πῶς κέν τις ἀκούσαι ’how could anyone hear’)
__broaden__.τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’) · also neut. nom. sg. agreeing with ἔγχος after εἴ: ’any’ (εἴ τί τοι ἔγχος ’if any spear of yours’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆδος after εἴ: ’some’ (εἴ πέρ τί σε κῆδος ἱκάνει ’if some concern reaches you’) · also neut. acc. sg. indefinite, agreeing with ἔπος: ’some (word)’
__broaden__.αἵματος: αἷμα — blood; neut. gen. sg., gen. of what one is glutted with, after ἆσαι: ’with blood’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on φόνον: ’of blood’ (φόνον αἵματος ’gore of blood’) · also neut. gen. sg., of origin after ἐξ: ’of (my) blood’ (αἵματος ἐξ ἐμεῦ ’of blood from me’)
__broaden__.θήβῃ: Θήβη — Thebe, city of Eëtion in the Troad; fem. dat. sg., place where: ’in Thebe’ · also Θήβη — Thebe (Boeotian Thebes), birthplace of Heracles; fem. dat. sg., place where: ’in Thebe’
__broaden__.ἄργος: Ἄργος — Argos, the Argive land (Greece); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also the Pelasgian Argos, a district of northern Greece; neut. acc. sg. · also Ἄργος Ἀχαιϊκόν, Achaean Argos, the Peloponnesian land of Mycenae and Tiryns; neut. acc. sg., of motion: ’to Argos’
